title: Futuristic HUD lab 3 (source of the round-3 templates)
summary: The 8 comps the round-3 Futuristic HUD templates were built and verified in: biometric scan, drone telemetry, boot sequence, holographic turntable (faux 3D), mission briefing, voice waveform, orbit tracker and warning cascade.
use_when: You want to see a round-3 HUD template working before using it, see how faux 3D is baked to keys (a turning wireframe box, turning globe meridians, a satellite hidden behind a planet), or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py after changing its copy.
parameters: colours (linear light; text colours converted with BT.709)
text content (sample copy: names, numbers and places are invented)
turntable: box half-sizes, tilt, focal length and turn speed (regenerate; edges are baked every 2 f)
orbit: planet radius, orbit size and tilt, satellite start and travel (regenerate)
waveform: wavelengths, travel and the amplitude keys
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-28
copy_notes: No media; nothing to relink. The body, map and planet are shape stand-ins.
Each comp has a 'Lab bg' rectangle; templates are extracted with --drop "Lab bg".
Clip ids are unique per comp (fbs_, ftm_, fbt_, fho_, fmb_, fvw_, fob_, fwc_).
FH Telemetry: the pitch ladder is parented (parentId) to the Horizon line, a visible centred pivot.
FH Voice waveform: each Wave is masked by its own soft 'Wave window' (mask.make, window first, then parent.clear).
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/futuristic_hud_lab3.py writes the comps; every move is baked as keys (no presets); open with edit.open {force:true}, make the three masks, then edit.save.
Every comp lints 0 errors / 0 warnings with contrast:true (notes: repeated_key_value on holds, speed_jump on the scan stop and the stepped progress fill; intended).
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-28
